method.warmup: one request per worker before each stage
method.measurement: closed loop persistent HTTP connection per worker; nearest-rank percentiles; alternating direct/gateway stage order each run; 250ms runtime sampling
method.limits: Local fixture evidence, not an open-loop capacity test. Python generator, fixture, gateway and Docker Redis share a host. End-to-end percentiles must not be subtracted as per-request overhead.

soak.checks: Every disconnect canceled upstream; every round drained active streams/attempts/slots/shared jobs/waiters/usage within 5s; heap/goroutines reported without a leak-free claim.
